synth.final_message:
`python3 check.py` prints **ALL PASS**: all 30 of 30 transitions replay exactly.

The mechanics in `program.py`:

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Cursor slots | The x positions of the legend columns. A legend that is 7 cells or less from the previous one is part of the same slot, so the cursor skips x=27. |
| Cursor rows | The y of each legend row minus 4. |
| Action 4 | Moves to the next slot. From the last slot it goes to the first slot of the next row. From the last row it goes back to the first row. |
| Action 3 | Moves to the previous slot. |
| Actions 1, 2 | No change was observed, so the program does nothing for them. |

These rules are not confirmed because the data has no example of them:
- Action 3 from the first slot of a row: I assumed it goes to the last slot of the previous row.
- Actions 1 and 2 (probably edit actions on the legends): no transition shows what they change.
